title: 测出一个网络的等效电阻
summary: 五个电阻的串并联网络：先算 Req，再用 Req = V / I 把它测出来。
concepts: measured vs calculated 测量与计算
description: 把一个串并联网络化简成一个等效电阻 Req，然后用电流表和电压读数把它“测”出来。电路：+9 V → 电流表 AM1 → R1（1 kΩ）→ 结点 A；A → R2（2.2 kΩ）→ GND；A → R3（1 kΩ）→ 结点 B；B → R4（3.3 kΩ）→ GND，B → R5（4.7 kΩ）→ GND。

cards.title: 一个盒子，几个电阻？
text: 照目标电路图搭好这个五电阻网络。想象把它装进一个盒子，只露出两根线：从外面看，它就像**一个**电阻。这个电阻是多少？

cards.title: 从最远处往回收
text: - 先 $R_4 \parallel R_5$，再串 $R_3$，再与 $R_2$ 并联，最后串 $R_1$，得到 $R_{eq}$。
- 有了 $R_{eq}$，总电流 $I = \frac{9\ \text{V}}{R_{eq}}$；再一路往回算 A、B 两点的电压。
- 反过来，只要测出电压和电流，$R_{eq} = \frac{V}{I}$——不用拆盒子。

cards.title: 量电流，算 Req，再量两个结点
text: - 读 AM1 的电流，用 9 V 除以它得到 Req。
- 再用万用表量 A、B 对 GND 的电压。检查通过后把读数填进测量题。

cards.title: 带走
text: - **等效电阻 = 从两个端口看进去的电阻。** 盒子里怎么接都行，外面只看到 V / I。
- 真实万用表也有欧姆档能直接量电阻，但必须**断电**测；通电时就用 V / I——就是这里的方法。
- 真实电流表的负担电阻有几欧到十几欧，会让 V / I 算出来的结果偏大这么多。

en.title: Measuring a network's equivalent resistance
en.summary: A series-parallel network of five resistors: calculate Req first, then measure it with Req = V / I.
en.description: Reduce a series-parallel network to one equivalent resistance Req, then "measure" it with an ammeter and voltage readings. Circuit: +9 V → ammeter AM1 → R1 (1 kΩ) → node A; A → R2 (2.2 kΩ) → GND; A → R3 (1 kΩ) → node B; B → R4 (3.3 kΩ) → GND, B → R5 (4.7 kΩ) → GND.

measurements.ask: Ammeter AM1 reading I (the total current)
From your reading, the equivalent resistance Req = 9 V / I
measurements.explain: Step by step: R4 ∥ R5 ≈ 1.939 kΩ, plus R3 = 2.939 kΩ, in parallel with R2 = 1.258 kΩ, plus R1 ≈ 2.258 kΩ.

measurements.ask: Multimeter: node A to GND, V(A)
Multimeter: node B to GND, V(B)

hints: Give A and B one metal strip (column) each, then bridge the columns with resistors.
The far ends of R2, R4 and R5 all go to GND (the blue rail).
The ammeter goes in series between +9V and R1: red lead on the +9V side.
tests: Total current and the voltages at A and B are sensible

cards.title: A box with how many resistors?
text: Build this five-resistor network from the target schematic. Imagine it inside a box with only two wires showing: from the outside it looks like **one** resistor. What is its value?

cards.title: Fold it back from the far end
text: - First $R_4 \parallel R_5$, add $R_3$, put that in parallel with $R_2$, finally add $R_1$: that is $R_{eq}$.
- With $R_{eq}$ the total current is $I = \frac{9\ \text{V}}{R_{eq}}$; then work back to the voltages at A and B.
- The other way round: measure the voltage and the current and $R_{eq} = \frac{V}{I}$ — no need to open the box.

cards.title: Measure the current, work out Req, measure two nodes
text: - Read AM1's current and divide 9 V by it for Req.
- Then measure A and B relative to GND with the multimeter. When the check passes, fill in the questions.

cards.title: Take away
text: - **Equivalent resistance = the resistance seen looking into two terminals.** However the box is wired inside, outside you only see V / I.
- A real multimeter has an ohms range to measure resistance directly, but only with the **power off**; with power on, you use V / I — this method.
- A real ammeter's burden resistance of a few ohms to a dozen ohms makes V / I come out that much too high.

tests.name: 总电流和 A、B 两点电压合理
各支路电流合理（KCL 成立）

measurements.ask: 电流表 AM1 的读数 I（总电流）
用你的读数算等效电阻 Req = 9 V / I
measurements.explain: 逐步化简：R4 ∥ R5 ≈ 1.939 kΩ，串 R3 得 2.939 kΩ，并 R2 得 1.258 kΩ，串 R1 得 ≈ 2.258 kΩ。

measurements.ask: 万用表：结点 A 对 GND 的电压 V(A)
万用表：结点 B 对 GND 的电压 V(B)

hints: 给 A、B 各分一条金属条（一列），再用电阻跨接各列。
R2 的另一端、R4 和 R5 的另一端都接 GND（蓝轨）。
电流表串在 +9V 和 R1 之间：红表笔接 +9V 那一侧。
